claims.claim: DiagonalGaussianDistribution splits parameter channels into mean and logvar, clamps logvar to [-30,20], uses std=exp(logvar/2), sample=mean+std*epsilon, and mode returns mean.

The plain encode/decode/forward path applies learned encoder/quant conv/decoder operations without applying the configuration scaling_factor. Slicing and tiling start disabled; forward selects posterior mode by default.
The full SD text-to-image pipeline divides its diffusion latent by vae.config.scaling_factor before decode, then applies its safety-check and image-postprocessing path.

PIL bytes are divided by 255 in float32, NHWC is transposed to BCHW, normalize computes 2*x-1, denormalize computes (y/2+1/2).clamp(0,1), numpy_to_pil rounds 255 times the displayed floating image to uint8.
With one CPU torch.Generator and CPU target, randn_tensor calls torch.randn with the supplied shape/generator/device/dtype.
The released manifest-verified config explicitly declares scaling_factor=0.18215, latent_channels=4, and four encoder/decoder block widths [128,256,512,512].

interpretation_notes: The scaling coefficient c is a frozen coordinate convention. Scaling latent by c changes its variance by c^2; a single later image does not identify the original aggregate training distribution.

The AutoencoderKL scaling_factor docstring describes a component-wise standard deviation, but executable scaling is multiplication by c and inverse division. LDM Appendix G and its author implementation provide the normalization formula and should anchor an explanation of the training rescaling.

LDM Appendix G displays a pooled scalar variance with denominator N=b*c*h*w; the fixed author code calls z.flatten().std() without an explicit correction setting. Its behavior depends on the framework default; no historical training run was reproduced here.

Projection onto [0,1] cannot increase squared error for a [0,1] target. Subsequent uint8 quantization has an additional rounding effect; the projection property applies to the clipped floating tensor.
Correct multiply-then-divide scale round trips can have floating-point rounding residuals; equality should be assessed numerically before image quantization.
For nonlinear D, the posterior latent mode/mean need not decode to the posterior mean image or to the latent that minimizes a chosen pixel reconstruction loss.
scope: Read fixed source and configuration; remote byte comparisons; AST and tiny function/analytic checks only. No VAE weight load or encoder/decoder forward.
